enabled.label: Show HTML page
enabled.hint: Replace the map view with this page for the selected audience.

url.label: Page URL
url.hint: Enter an external HTTP(S) URL or a path served by Foundry, such as modules/html-as-scene/dist/index.html.

bridge.label: Foundry snapshot bridge
bridge.hint: Fetch the HTML file, embed it as srcdoc, and expose the local working document plus the snapshot published on this scene. External pages must allow CORS requests.

storageKey.label: Local storage key
storageKey.hint: Browser localStorage key used for this page's working document, such as navigationstisch.orbit.v1. The published snapshot is stored separately on the Foundry server.

hideBoard.label: Stop rendering the board
hideBoard.hint: Hide the Foundry canvas while the page is visible to reduce rendering work.

trust.label: Page trust
trust.hint: Strict isolates the page from Foundry. Trusted removes the iframe sandbox completely.

interactive.label: Interactive
interactive.hint: When disabled, pointer input passes through the page to the Foundry canvas.

audience.label: Audience
audience.hint: Choose which connected users see the page.

trust.confirmContent: Trusted pages are not sandboxed. A same-origin page can access your Foundry session and the surrounding page. Only continue for HTML you control.

validation.invalidUrl: This is not a valid HTTP(S) URL.
validation.mixedContent: This HTTP page will be blocked when Foundry is served over HTTPS. Use HTTPS instead.
validation.localMissing: Foundry could not find this local path (HTTP {status}). You may still save it, but the page will not load.
validation.localUnreachable: Foundry could not check this local path. You may still save it, but verify the path before using the scene.

notifications.bridgeFetchFailed: HTML as Scene could not fetch the external page for the snapshot bridge: {url}. The page must allow CORS requests.
notifications.localLoadFailed: HTML as Scene could not load the local page: {url}
notifications.loadTimeout: The page did not finish loading: {url}. It may be unavailable or may forbid iframe embedding through X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy.
